name: Magic
overview: Scripture clearly condemns all forms of magic and occult practices, including witchcraft, divination, and consulting familiar spirits, as seen in commands to not allow witches to live (Exodus 22:18) and prohibitions against enchantments and observing times (Leviticus 19:26, Deuteronomy 18:10). God warns that those who turn to wizards or familiar spirits will face severe judgment, including being cut off from their people or put to death (Leviticus 19:31, 20:6, 20:27). These passages emphasize the holiness of God and the danger of seeking supernatural power apart from Him.
